# MediCare Plus — free Next.js hospital website template

> A production-quality, MIT-licensed website template for a multi-specialty
> clinic with online appointment booking. Built with Next.js 16 (App Router),
> React 19 and TypeScript 5. Live demo: https://medicare.vivekkumarsingh.in

## What this site is

MediCare Plus is a DEMO TEMPLATE, not a real medical provider. Every doctor,
phone number, address, price and statistic on it is fictional, no appointment
is really booked, and nothing on it is medical advice. It exists so developers
can clone a complete, accessible clinic website and replace the mock data in
/data with their own.

## Pages

- /             Homepage: hero with department search, clinic statistics, the
                eight departments, featured consultants, three charts
                ("Care in numbers"), patient testimonials, FAQ.
- /doctors      All consultants, filterable by department via ?department=slug.
- /doctors/[slug]  One consultant: biography, qualifications timeline,
                read-only weekly clinic timetable, booking call to action.
- /departments  The eight specialties, what each treats, and who leads it.
- /book         The four-step appointment booking flow: (1) department and
                doctor, (2) date and time slot, (3) patient details,
                (4) OTP verification, then a confirmation with a booking ID.
- /built-with   Every page section mapped to the component that renders it.

## Departments

Cardiology, Orthopaedics, Paediatrics, Neurology, Dermatology, ENT,
Gynaecology, General Medicine.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: Do I need a referral to book?
A: No. You can book any specialist directly, without a GP referral. A referral
   letter is still useful if you have one, because it saves the consultant
   re-taking a history you have already given once.

Q: Which insurance providers are accepted?
A: Cashless on the Star Health, HDFC ERGO, ICICI Lombard, Niva Bupa, Care
   Health and CGHS panels. Other insurers are claimed by reimbursement using
   the itemised invoice issued at reception.

Q: How do I cancel or reschedule?
A: Through the link in the confirmation SMS or email, up to two hours before
   the appointment. Cancellation in that window is free; rescheduling is
   always free, however late.

Q: Is online consultation available?
A: Yes, for follow-ups, report reviews and repeat prescriptions in every
   department except Orthopaedics theatre lists. First visits for a new
   problem need to be in person.

## Stack

Next.js 16.3 (App Router, Turbopack, async request APIs) · React 19 ·
TypeScript 5 · Node 20.9+ / 22 LTS. No Tailwind, no CSS-in-JS, no UI
dependency other than the component library below. Server components by
default; the booking flow, navbar, clock, map and copy button are the only
client islands.

## Using this template

This site is open source under the MIT licence. Developers can clone it as a
starting point; clinics and agencies can rebrand it and put it in front of real
patients. There is no licence fee, no attribution requirement and no paid tier.

  git clone https://github.com/intellectwithvivek/MediCare-Plus.git

Repository: https://github.com/intellectwithvivek/MediCare-Plus
Author: Vivek Kumar Singh — https://vivekkumarsingh.in/

Replace the mock data in /data and the site details in lib/site.ts, then
deploy. There is no backend, no database and no authentication to wire up.
